extraction.Name: Christopher Colombe
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded March 8, 1918, by D. A. Sinclair
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the First Trust Company, Omaha, for $2500; conveyed to C. Gustaf Huddin for $2500 subject to the mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612451; Northeast quarter, section 14, township 100, north of range 77; receipt for patent signed February 16, 1918, by the allottee; deed to C. Gustaf Huddin dated August 1, 1918, signed by Colombe and wife
